caption:
One failed backend should change where NEW requests go. Follow GET /orders through a configured load-balancer pool: readiness checks, round-robin selection, failure thresholds and graceful draining. A health check does not guarantee that an already-running call is rescued or automatically retried.

Inspect readiness results, compare backend request counts, and test failure plus shutdown behavior.

System Design Crash Course · Lesson 09
#systemdesign #beyondlocalhost

takeaway: Inspect readiness results and failure thresholds
Compare request counts across eligible backends
Test failover and in-flight request handling

scenes.title: Which server gets this call?
scenes.narration: This request stops at a failed server. A health-aware balancer sends it to a healthy one.
scenes.note: A configured health-aware pool avoids this failed target.

scenes.title: One address, several backends
scenes.narration: Your orders request reaches one public entry point. The balancer forwards it to a backend from its eligible pool.
scenes.note: The same public address can front several backend instances.

scenes.title: Check before sending new work
scenes.narration: An active check probes a configured readiness endpoint. A passing result marks that instance eligible for new requests.
scenes.note: The check result records whether this target may receive new requests.

scenes.title: Take turns, not guesses
scenes.narration: For this example, round-robin rotates new requests between eligible instances. It does not measure how busy each one is.
scenes.note: One request reaches one selected backend, not both.

scenes.title: A failed check changes the pool
scenes.narration: After configured failure thresholds, a failing instance leaves the eligible pool. New orders requests go to the remaining healthy instance.
scenes.note: Health checks guide selection after their configured thresholds.

scenes.title: An old call can still fail
scenes.narration: That does not rescue every in-flight request. A call already sent to a failing backend may still time out.
scenes.note: The old call stops here; any retry needs an explicit safe retry policy.

scenes.title: Let existing work finish
scenes.narration: Mark the instance unready for new traffic, then allow existing orders requests to finish before shutting the instance down.
scenes.note: Configured graceful shutdown gives existing work time to finish.

scenes.title: Test it before the outage
scenes.narration: Test a failed instance, inspect the readiness decision, and compare backend request counts before trusting your failover setup.
scenes.note: Inspect the real path and failure behavior, not just the diagram.
